Description:
[b][size=3]Animated Gemstones [color=#ffe599]1.1.7![/color]



[/size]Version [color=#ffe599]1.1.7[/color]
GingerIsland and 1.5.0 compatible items
-Radioactive ore / Ingot - Static
-Cindershard and Cindershard nodes - Animated
-OmniGeodeNode for Volcano area - Animated
-Mudnode - Static
-Matching skin for a dangerous monster disguised a node.

This 1.1 version contain 41 animations of Gemstones and Crystals.
-Animated Geodes and GemNodes
-Added the rest of the minerals as static ones with the same style. [color=#ffff00]
[/color]-Static Ores [b]-
[color=#ffff00]-[/color]Ingots and mineralNodes!
[/b]-Gemmed and Mystic Nodes. Animated
(Animated gifs on the images.)
[color=#ffff00]New![/color]: Matching skin for a monster in the mines. [color=#ffff00]1.1.4

[/color]Changes on 1.1.5 [b][color=#ffff00]New![/color][/b]
-Clean file structure! (Delete old version´s folder)
-Meteorite
-Ice Mine Crystals
-Missing Celestine mineral

Added the 3 special GeodeNodes that appear in the Mining and 4 corners Farm-Maps.  [color=#ffff00]New in 1.1.3[/color]


Each one can be turned on and off via [color=#00ff00]Config file[/color] inside this mod folder when you launch the game at least once.

Example : 

"[color=#00ffff]Diamond[/color]" : "true"
"[color=#00ffff]Emerald[/color]" : "false"

In this example you will have an animated Diamond while the Emerald will stay vanilla or Edited by another mod.

Smapi
Content Patcher

[color=#ff7700]Troubleshooting[/color]
[color=#616161]
[/color]If an object is flickering,  its because 2 mods are targeting the same tile/sprite.
Example : 
The primatic Shard Test on CP-Animations
And the prismatic Shard in this mod.

Fix: Remove/disable one  (it might be patched on new version on Nexus)

Know Conflict for "SpriteMaster" Mod.    (Know by both tool makers).  [color=#ffff00]!!![/color]
Conflict : Flickering images

-This "can" replace the prismatic Bar sprite in the PrismaticTools mod
You NEED to do it manually, since that mod is not a content patcher one.

-Go inside your "Prismatic Tools" mod
-open the Assets/assets folder
-Replace prismaticBar with this file.
